# Offline OCR third-party notices

Kitchen Companion includes these pinned, unmodified runtime assets so image
recognition can operate without a network connection:

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0
- `@tesseract.js-data/eng` 1.0.0, `4.0.0_best_int` English model

The Tesseract.js and tesseract.js-core license texts are preserved in the
`licenses` directory beside this notice. Package versions remain explicit in
the containing directory name and in Kitchen Companion's offline cache name.
